title: Residue fibre cohomology of a K-flat sheaf representative
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], x a point [def-weil-residue-field], and P a K-flat complex of structure-sheaf modules [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let E in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] be equipped with Q(P) ≅ E. For every integer i, derivedFiberCohomology X E i x [def-sc-derived-fiber-betti] is linearly equivalent over kappa(x) to H^i(kappa(x) tensor over O_X,x the stalk complex P_x [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]). No ring derived category, boundedness or termwise freeness is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06YI and 06YJ; derived pullback computation on K-flat models, with Tag 0098 and one-point evaluation

proof.text: The universal-property witness specifying derivedPullback has a counit invertible on P. Identify its underlying additive functor with tensorPullback by its recorded object and morphism equalities. Compose the quotient-to-Qh factorization, this invertible counit, and the tensor functor quotient factorization to get L i_x^* Q(P) ≅ Q(i_x^* P). Transport along Q(P) ≅ E and apply derived homology.

Evaluation of modules on the one-point ringed space Spec kappa(x) is an equivalence, hence preserves finite limits and colimits. Restriction of scalars along GammaSpecIso inverse is exact. Their composite therefore commutes with homology; use the short-complex mapHomologyIso in degree i.
Lift the natural isomorphism of residue pullback global sections to complexes, apply homology, and compose with the preceding two isomorphisms. ModuleCat.toLinearEquiv retains the kappa(x)-action.

theorem nonempty_kFlat_stalk_residueCohomology_linearEquiv
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (x : X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (X.residueField x)).toRingedSpace))]
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E) (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (derivedFiberCohomology X E i x ≃ₗ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField
      (X.presheaf.stalk x)]
        ((((ModuleCat.extendScalars
          (IsLocalRing.residue (X.presheaf.stalk x))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
              (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)).homology i))
